title: Shabana Mahmood expected to unveil plans to move asylum seekers from hotels to barracks
summary: New home secretary is expected to unveil plans to use military sites as Labour seeks to harden immigration policy Shabana Mahmood is expected to unveil plans to move asylum seekers from hotels into military barracks as Labour seeks to harden its immigration policy amid rising numbers of crossings in the channel. The new home secretary is reportedly set to announce the use of Ministry of Defence sites to house people after a wave of protests outside migrant accommodation over the summer. Continue reading...
